---
title: "Scale Validation in R"
comments: false
---

Psychometric validation of personality, vocational-interest and symptom questionnaires and an ability test in R: item lists, inter-item and subscale correlations, reliability, exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis, parallel analysis, measurement invariance, bifactor models, item response theory, and tests of theoretical structure.

| Instrument | Tutorial |
|---|---|
| BFI-44 | [BFI-44 Validation](VALIDATION_BFI44.rmd) |
| IPIP-50 (OCEAN) | [IPIP-50 / OCEAN Validation](VALIDATION_OCEAN.rmd) |
| IPIP-50 (OCEAN) | [OCEAN: descriptives, reliability and structure](VALIDATION_DESCRIPTIVES_OCEAN.rmd) |
| IPIP-HEXACO (240 items) | [HEXACO Validation: Six Factors or Five?](VALIDATION_HEXACO.rmd) |
| IPIP-NEO-120 (30 facets) | [IPIP-NEO-120: Measurement Invariance Across Sex, Countries and Age](VALIDATION_IPIPNEO120.rmd) |
| RIASEC-48 (Holland interests) | [RIASEC Validation: Recovering Holland's Hexagon](VALIDATION_RIASEC.rmd) |
| DASS-42 (depression, anxiety, stress) | [DASS-42 Validation: Three Scales or One?](VALIDATION_DASS.rmd) |
| Vocabulary IQ Test (45 items) | [Vocabulary IQ Test Validation: Item Response Theory](VALIDATION_VIQT.rmd) |
